verified_behaviors: P1: POST /loop/start with user_message='yes' and NO pending_scan on session returns {needs_clarification:true, reason:'no_pending_proposal', message:"I don't have a pending proposal to confirm yet..."} — NOT the old 'too broad' CLARIFICATION_MESSAGE. VERIFIED live.

Ambiguity gate unchanged: 'fix it' and 'improve the app' still return the original 'That's a bit broad...' clarification (needs_clarification=true, reason != no_pending_proposal). VERIFIED live for both messages.

P1 grounding flow end-to-end: seeded pending_scan on chat_sessions doc → bare 'yes' → grounding resolved (no clarification, no 'no_pending_proposal'), pending_scan CONSUMED (cleared from doc after use). Downstream 403 (GitHub App) hit AFTER grounding path — proves gate was skipped. VERIFIED live.

P2 wiring: services/loop_engine.py::_do_plan (line 676-702) attaches plan.scan_coverage from check_plan_scan_consistency() when self.source_findings is set, and blocks via self._fail('plan', ...) when mismatched_files non-empty BEFORE self.context['plan']=plan. Verified by unit tests test_plan_matching_scan_files_has_no_mismatch, test_plan_targeting_wrong_files_is_blocked, test_partial_plan_shows_visible_deferral_not_silent (all pass).

Frontend: ChatPanel.jsx::formatPlanMarkdown() (line 3386-3430) renders '_Fixing X of Y findings from the scan · Z deferred_' header when coverage.total_findings>0, and appends '**Not in this plan** (N):' section listing each deferred finding. Code-review confirmed.
Regression: normal concrete task ('fix the login bug in Signup.jsx') passed ambiguity gate & grounding cleanly — hit downstream 409 (loop_already_running), NOT any P1 clarification. VERIFIED live.

Regression: Mode D 'pending_fix_task' + is_fix_confirmation path in routers/chat.py untouched by this build — separate list _CONFIRMATORY in intent_grounding.py deliberately excludes 'fix it'/'apply the fix' per code comment (line 31-35).
Mode E pending_scan write (routers/chat.py ~1855-1875) persists {findings, project_id, created_at} to chat_sessions when audit produces findings with filepath. Code-review confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: intent_grounding.resolve_confirmatory_scope() — when session_id is missing but message IS confirmatory, returns {grounded:True, no_pending:True}. Correct behavior but consider logging this at info level for observability (current code has no log line here).

plan_scan_contract._norm() strips leading './' but not 'src/../' or other path normalizations. If planner ever emits non-canonical paths, mismatch check could be over-eager. Low risk since planner is prompted with the exact filepaths from findings; noting for future robustness.

loop.py line 187-206: source_findings and effective_message initialized OUTSIDE the try/except guard block. If resolve_confirmatory_scope raises (e.g. transient DB error), start_loop 500s. Consider wrapping in try/except with warn log + fallback to raw body.user_message. Not a bug today (no observed exceptions in tests) but a defensive gap.
